description: This file defines the public API for keyboard scan matrix devices in the Zephyr project, including callback types, API structures, and function prototypes for configuring and controlling keyboard scan drivers.

methods.name: kscan_config
methods.description: Configures a keyboard scan instance with a callback for key events.

methods.name: kscan_enable_callback
methods.description: Enables the callback for keyboard scan events.

methods.name: kscan_disable_callback
methods.description: Disables the callback for keyboard scan events.
